Talent0_2Ability.name: Good Medicine Tastes Bitter
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: Can equip Manipulator in backpack slot, Manipulator weight reduces by <color=#F74848>-300</color>. When using Knuckle or Pilebunker to attack an enemy while carrying a Manipulator, deals <buf ID=900017>[Fixed DMG]</buf> equal to <color=#F74848>0.3x</color> Manipulator Repair AMT to the enemy part with lowest HP.

Talent3_5Ability.name: Good Medicine Tastes Bitter
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
Can equip Manipulator in backpack slot, Manipulator weight reduces by <color=#F74848>-300</color>. When using Knuckle or Pilebunker to attack an enemy while carrying a Manipulator, deals <buf ID=900017>[Fixed DMG]</buf> equal to <color=#F74848>0.35x</color> Manipulator Repair AMT to the enemy part with lowest HP.
<buf ID=5009418>[Resonance Pulse]</buf> DMG multiplier increases to <color=#F74848>0.35x</color>. Repair skills range <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

100001.name: Mobile Warfare 1
100001.SpecificEffects: After breaking a part, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered. Unable to move before the attack, and this can be effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

700009.name: Wide-Range Repair
700009.describe: Restores the HP of all allies within the selected <range type=1>2-tile diamond area</range>. Repair amount is equal to <color=#F74848>1.0x</color> Manipulator Repair AMT. Can repair <color=#F74848>1</color> destroyed part.

500903.name: Targeted Service
500903.describe: Restores all part HP of a single target equals to <color=#F74848>2.0x</color> Manipulator Repair AMT. Can restore <color=#F74848>1</color> destroyed part.

500904.name: Double-Sided Restoration
500904.describe: Restores all part HP of a single target equals to <color=#F74848>2.3</color> Manipulator Repair AMT. Can restore <color=#F74848>1</color>destroyed part and deals <buf ID=900017>[Fixed DMG]</buf> to all enemies within <color=#F74848>2</color> adjacent tiles of the target equal to <color=#F74848>0.3x</color> Manipulator Repair AMT.

500905.name: Emergency Dose
500905.SpecificEffects: When using Manipulator, if the target is an ally with <color=#F74848>60%</color> or less HP, increases Repair AMT by <color=#F74848>15%</color>, if the target is an enemy with <color=#F74848>60%</color> or less HP, increases <buf ID=900017>[Fixed DMG]</buf> dealt by <color=#F74848>10%</color>.

500906.name: Readiness
500906.SpecificEffects: Each turn, the AP Cost of the 1st skill decreases by <color=#F74848>1</color>, with a minimum cost of <color=#F74848>1</color> AP.

500907.name: Poison Cast
500907.SpecificEffects: When talent <buf ID=5009501>[Good Medicine Tastes Bitter]</buf> or <buf ID=5009418>[Resonance Pulse]</buf> triggers, applies <color=#F74848>1</color> random debuff to the target, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

500908.name: Ghost Patrol
500908.describe: Uses a Knuckle or a Pilebunker to attack in a designated direction, dealing <color=#F74848>1.35x</color> DMG to the target hit. This skill prioritizes the part with highest HP. If there are adjacent enemies in that direction, can continue to attack adjacent units (attacking up to <color=#F74848>4</color> enemy units), then stops on the opposite side of the farthest target. The talent <buf ID=900017>[Fixed DMG]</buf> triggered by this attack is increased by <color=#F74848>50%</color>.

100011.name: Mobile Warfare 2
100011.SpecificEffects: Upon triggering <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, allows movement of <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles before attacking.

100021.name: Mobile Warfare 3
100021.SpecificEffects: Destroying the target can trigger <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf>, allowing action with full movement distance.

100022.name: Power Innovation 2
100022.SpecificEffects: When breaking a part, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

500931.name: Emergency Repair 1
500931.SpecificEffects: At the end of the action, randomly select a single adjacent (<color=#F74848>1</color> tile) ally to perform <buf ID=900018>[Passive Repair]</buf>. The repair amount is <color=#F74848>0.6x</color> the Manipulator's Repair AMT and cannot repair damaged parts.

100033.name: Mobile Warfare 4
100033.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> or <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf>'s effective times per turn <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

500934.name: Emergency Repair 2
500934.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900018>[Passive Repair]</buf> selects targets within the adjacent (<color=#F74848>2</color> tiles) area.

500935.name: Emergency Repair 3
500935.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900018>[Passive Repair]</buf>'s Repair AMT is now <color=#F74848>1x</color> that of the Manipulator.

500936.name: Emergency Repair 4
500936.SpecificEffects: The number of targets that <buf ID=900018>[Passive Repair]</buf> can repair increases by <color=#F74848>1</color>.

500941.name: False Doctor 1
500941.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=900017>[Fixed DMG]</buf> is triggered by Manipulator, applies <buf ID=5009418>[Resonance Pulse]</buf> to the target.

100043.name: Power Innovation 3
100043.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, additionally restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

500944.name: False Doctor 2
500944.SpecificEffects: Repair skills can target enemies, dealing <buf ID=900017>[Fixed DMG]</buf> equal to <color=#F74848>50%</color> Repair AMT.

500945.name: False Doctor 3
500945.SpecificEffects: When actively attacking, for each <color=#F74848>1%</color> bonus Repair AMT, increases DMG dealt by <color=#F74848>1%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>40%</color>. When actively using repair skills, for each <color=#F74848>2%</color> bonus DMG, increases Repair AMT by <color=#F74848>1%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>20%</color>.

500946.name: False Doctor 4
500946.SpecificEffects: After actively attacking, triggers <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, can move <color=#F74848>3</color> tiles before attacking, and cannot use repair skills with this action. This <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> effect can trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.
